ruled_by: E-0013 Addendum 2 (S-0039), Ruling 2 / F-U9 - hash-pin in research/, do not commit the artifacts
read_time_check: python tools/e0013_pins.py --verify   (re-hashes every artifact below and aborts on any mismatch; a consuming job calls `read_corpus()` INSTEAD of opening positions.jsonl)
why_this_file_is_the_control: A hash pin is only as good as the discipline around it. S-0039 Ruling 2 names two disciplines: the pin must be committed BEFORE the read it protects, and somebody must re-hash AT READ TIME. This manifest plus tools/e0013_pins.py discharge the second. Without the re-hash the pin is a comment with a hexadecimal shape.
artifacts_out_of_git: positions.jsonl is 13,004,718 B, derived, and regenerable from the pinned dataset + tool commit + split salt. Per Ruling 2 it is NOT committed; this manifest is the pin. build/ and m0_audit/ are gitignored, so these paths exist only on the machine that ran the pass.

positions.jsonl.role: the E-0013 count-only measurement. Every row's y is null. This digest is the digest of a MEASUREMENT and is NOT, and must never be quoted as, the fitter's corpus digest.

split_map.json.role: the game->split assignment. A pure function of (SPLIT_SALT, game_id), so this digest is INVARIANT under the F-U7 dedup-key change and is the pin for conjunct (b) whichever mode produced the positions.

report.json.role: the provenance record for the count-only pass. SUPERSEDED IN TWO RESPECTS, both recorded here so no reader inherits them unknowingly: (1) its src_commit reads 9f6574c, the PARENT of da93d9c, so its attribution is stale - the S-0039 section 9 defect; (2) it carries a `band` key for an instrument retired by S-0039 Ruling 1, and it has no `corpus` or `provenance` block at all, both added by this session's fixes. It is pinned as WHAT IT IS - a pre-fix measurement record - not as a current one. The digest is still a control: these bytes are the ones E-00015's executor will be reconciling against, and `tools/e0013_pins.py --modes` reports the schema gap as a NAMED state rather than passing it silently.

fitter_corpus.null_reason: NOT YET PINNED, and this null is the honest state rather than a gap. The full-mode (labelled) extraction has not been re-emitted: doing so is a run of the extractor on the pinned real dataset, which is outside this job's scope and is a separate seat's pass. Until it is, no fitter corpus digest exists and read_corpus() REFUSES rather than handing back a count-only hash. The count-only digest ac8c92f0... is a MEASUREMENT's digest and is not a substitute.
fitter_corpus.required_before: any fitter or the E-00014 feasibility pass may read TRAIN
fitter_corpus.how_to_produce: run tools/e0013_extract.py at a clean commit (it now asserts its own src_commit at write time), then record the resulting positions_sha256 here with is_fitter_corpus true and mode labelled
